name: Lake Nona Wave Hotel
insider_take: This cutting-edge hotel sits in Orlando's innovation district, where tech meets hospitality in a sleek lakefront setting just minutes from the magic.
whats_special: Lake Nona Wave Hotel is located in one of America's smartest cities - the Lake Nona district features autonomous vehicle testing, advanced medical research facilities, and sustainable urban planning. The hotel itself boasts a stunning rooftop pool with panoramic lake views and is part of a master-planned community that's home to major healthcare and technology companies.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view room on the upper floors for spectacular sunrise views over Lake Nona, and take advantage of the hotel's prime location - you're only 15 minutes from Orlando International Airport and 20 minutes from Disney World.
dont_miss: The nearby Boa Steakhouse for upscale dining, Lake Nona Golf & Country Club designed by Tom Fazio, and the innovative USTA National Campus - the world's largest tennis facility. The district's walking trails around the pristine lakes offer a peaceful escape from theme park crowds.
pros: Modern luxury hotel in innovative Lake Nona district
Close proximity to Orlando attractions and Disney World
Located in emerging tech and medical hub area
cons: Newer development area with limited nearby dining options
